delta.comment: PR #325 review-fix (2026-08-10). All three Plan-1 shipments are now uniformly TASK-ONLY: 124-S = 5 tasks, 125-S = 6 tasks, 126-S = 8 tasks (19 total); 117-F is a member of NO manifest and REMAINS QUEUED until all 19 children and all three shipments complete. Hardening gained H10.4; review gained F13 (P0, RESOLVED) and F14 (P1, RESOLVED-with-mitigation). RESIDUAL F14 for Ship: returnUnreleasedFeatureItems is NOT gated by explicitScope and clears parent_id on a non-member ancestor feature's unreleased descendants, so closing 124-S will orphan 117.006-T..117.019-T from 117-F (recoverable relationship change only - no closure, no archival, no data loss); Ship MUST re-adopt them under 117-F via adopt_item after closing 124-S and again after 125-S, and verify parentage before claiming the next shipment. NEVER re-add 117-F to a manifest.
